# Pagination

Moves between pages of results.

:label[In Brand expressive]{tone="info"}

## When to use it

**In Brand expressive:** A rare line-up table split across pages. Not on campaign sections.

- **Use it when:** A list or table split across pages.
- **Not when:** Steps of a task (progress).

Instead:

- [Progress](./progress.md): Steps of a task.
- [Table](./table.md): The rows being paged.

<a class="odv-anatref" href="./pagination/anatomy"><span class="odv-anatref-b"><b>Anatomy reference</b><span>Every part of the pagination, the job it does, and the decisions behind it. 6 parts.</span></span><span class="odv-anatref-go" aria-hidden="true">→</span></a>

## Words

- Headlines are short and bold. Three to six words.
- Verbs that move: Join, Try, Go.
- Playful in headlines, plain in errors.
- Use: Join, Drop, Go, Love. Avoid: Synergy, Leverage, Kindly.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Go
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Explore the drop

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

Test before you ship:

- [ ] The current page is marked; previous and next have names. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add pagination
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Tokens it reads

Pagination reads 6 tokens of its own, each an alias of a semantic token. Each row is one part: its own token, the semantic it aliases, and the value it ends at. Change a semantic and every component that reads it follows; override one of Pagination's tokens to change Pagination alone.
